question: Indian Space Policy, 2023 sets the stage for _________ participation in space industry.
solution:
The correct answer is **__private sector__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian Space Policy, 2023 sets the stage for private sector participation in the space industry.
 
• The policy aims to encourage and institutionalize private sector participation in the space sector's value chain, including the creation of space and ground-based assets. 
 
• The policy also allows Indian customers to directly procure space technology and services from public and private sources.
 
• It also gives non-governmental entities (NGEs) the ability to file with the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) and engage in commercial recovery of asteroid resources. 
 
• The policy's goal is to unlock the potential of India's youth and entrepreneurs by promoting private sector activity in high-technology areas, including space. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Public sector
 
• Owned and controlled by the government, with the goal of providing goods and services to the public at a reasonable cost. Public sector organizations include government agencies, state-owned enterprises, and municipalities. 
 
• Private sector
 
• Owned and operated by individuals or private groups, with the goal of making a profit. Private sector industries include manufacturing, technology, healthcare, and retail. 
 
• Joint sector
 
• Owned by both the government and private individuals, also known as public-private partnerships. Joint sector companies are an extension of the mixed economy concept, where both public and private enterprises work together to contribute to economic development.
